name: Weapon Bound
body:
You are only attuned to your deity’s weapon and no other.

Prerequisite: Devotion to a specific deity

Effect: You lose all proficiency with weapons except the favoured weapon of your deity. This flaw doesn’t grant you proficiency with that weapon however.
